runicskills.config.unavailable.body: The in-game config screen needs Yet Another Config Lib (YACL) v3 for Minecraft 1.20.1. Installed YACL: %s. Open the game log (latest.log) for the exact cause. All settings — including the enableItemLocks master toggle — can still be edited directly in config/RunicSkills/runicskills.common.json5.
runicskills.config.unavailable.schema: The in-game config screen could not be built because of a bug in Runic Skills itself (config field: %s), not because of your Yet Another Config Lib (YACL) install — reinstalling or changing YACL will not help. Please report the game log (latest.log) to the Runic Skills issue tracker. All settings — including the enableItemLocks master toggle — can still be edited directly in config/RunicSkills/runicskills.common.json5.
yacl3.config.runicskills:config.enableIt: Master toggle for the item-lock feature. If off, every entry in runicskills.lockItems.json5 (and every integration-generated lock) is ignored — players can use any item regardless of skill level.
yacl3.config.runicskills:config.maxActiv: Maximum number of perks a player can have enabled at once. 0 = unlimited (default). Server-authoritative; clients exceeding the cap are rejected.
yacl3.config.runicskills:config.perksPer: Optional scaled active-perk cap: derived cap = floor(EARNED global level * this value), where earned global level = total skill levels above the starting baseline (a fresh player is 0). 0 = disabled (default). Example: 0.5 grants the first slot after 2 earned levels, 3 slots after 6. When both this and maxActivePerks are non-zero, the smaller cap is enforced. If lowering this puts a player over budget, perk activation is frozen until they respec. Server-authoritative; synced on join.
yacl3.config.runicskills:config.maxPerkB: Optional hard ceiling on the perksPerGlobalLevel-derived cap (does not affect the flat maxActivePerks cap). 0 = no ceiling (default). Server-authoritative; synced to clients on join.
yacl3.config.runicskills:config.disabled: Perk registry names to disable. Disabled perks cannot be enabled or ranked up; existing ranks remain in save data but their effects are suppressed. Accepts registry path ("berserker") or full id ("runicskills:berserker").

Passive registry names to disable. Disabled passives cannot be leveled up and their attribute modifier is removed on next /skillsreload, login, or respawn. Existing level is retained. Accepts registry path ("attack_damage") or full id ("runicskills:attack_damage").
Power registry names to disable. Disabled powers cannot be equipped; previously-equipped entries are filtered out at runtime. Accepts registry path ("fire_mark") or full id ("runicskills:fire_mark").
yacl3.config.runicskills:config.hideDisa: If on, perks in disabledPerks are hidden from the skills screen entirely instead of shown locked. Does not change enforcement (disabled perks are always blocked) — this only controls UI visibility. Default off. Server-authoritative; synced on join.

If on, passives in disabledPassives are hidden from the skills screen entirely instead of shown with a locked level-up button. Does not change enforcement — this only controls UI visibility. Default off. Server-authoritative; synced on join.

If on, powers in disabledPowers are hidden from the powers screen entirely instead of shown greyed-out. Does not change enforcement — this only controls UI visibility. Default off. Server-authoritative; synced on join.
yacl3.config.runicskills:config.powerEna: If on, Powers that have no behaviour behind them yet become visible and equippable, badged as experimental. For development and for testing against an installed Iron's Spells. Default off — inert content does nothing at all.
yacl3.config.runicskills:config.perkSwap: Per-player cooldown (in ticks, 20 = 1 second) between enabling perks. 0 = no cooldown (default). Applies only when enabling a perk from rank 0; rank-ups and disables bypass it. Server-authoritative.
yacl3.config.runicskills:config.skillLev: Multiplier on the vanilla XP cost of leveling a skill. 1.0 = vanilla (default). 2.0 = twice as expensive. 0.5 = half price. Scales both the XP-points cost and the minimum-experience-level gate.
yacl3.config.runicskills:config.logError: If true, when populating the items a extra check will be made, if a item have a incorrect format it will log the line and continue loading without crashing
yacl3.config.runicskills:config.closeCra: If true, when trying to craft a non unlocked item, it will close the crafting the menu
yacl3.config.runicskills:config.dropLock: If true, locked items will be automatically dropped from player hands. Has no effect when enableItemLocks is off.
yacl3.config.runicskills:config.logTaczG: TAC:Zero have a special id system, so if you wanna get the id to restrict you need to enable this and shoot.
yacl3.config.runicskills:config.logSpell: Iron's Spell 'n Spellbooks have a unique spell id for each spell, so if you wanna get the id to restrict you need to enable this and cast the spell.
yacl3.config.runicskills:config.playersM: Global max level, the global level is calculated summing all skills level, so if this is set to 32 players will be able to only maximize 1 skill.
config.cloth-config.runicskills.lockItem:
How to add a lock item:
<Mod name>§b:§f<Item name>§b#§f<Skill>§b:§f<Level>

If you want add more skills just write: (you can add as many as you want)
<Mod name>§b:§f<Item name>§b#§f<Skill>§b:§f<Level>§b;§f<Skill>§b:§f<Level>§b...§f

If you want make the item droppable just add to the final §b<droppable>§f like this example:
minecraft§b:§ftotem_of_undying§b#§fconstitution§b:§f16§b;§fmagic:12§b<droppable>
config.cloth-config.runicskills.treasure:
How to add a treasure item:
<Mod name>§b:§f<Item name>

If you wanna add a nbt use §b{ }§f like this example:
<Mod name>§b:§f<Item name>§b{§fNBT§b}§f

Finally we have list, the list is if you got a treasure chance you will get 1 item from the list, to adding a list write:
<Name list>§bList[§f Here you can put as many items as you want, to separate them use §b;§f to close the list just use §b]§f
config.cloth-config.runicskills.converge:
How to add a convergence item: (to make it fair the convergence only will give you 1 result)
<Mod name>§b:§f<Item name>§b#§f<Mod name result>§b:§f<Item name result>

perk.runicskills.mechanism_mastery.descr: Dispensers and droppers near you fire %s sooner.
perk.runicskills.power_tools.description: Tool efficiency enchantment level effectively increased by %s.

screen.runicskills.powers.title: Runic Powers
power.runicskills.ember_trail.descriptio: After landing a Fire spell, your footfalls ignite anything that treads in your wake for 3s.
power.runicskills.kindle.description: The first fire-school hit after you apply Immolate deals +20%% damage.
power.runicskills.heat_haze.description: A melee hit with a burning enemy nearby detonates a 2-block fire pulse (8s ICD).
power.runicskills.scorched_earth.descrip: Your fire-field spells last 40%% longer and shred 15%% armor on entities inside them.
power.runicskills.pyroclasm.description: Immolated foes dying within 16 blocks detonate a chain fire burst (6/2s cap).
power.runicskills.frost_echo.description: Ice projectiles hitting terrain leave a 3-second chill patch.
power.runicskills.shatter.description: Damaging a fully-Frozen enemy shatters it for 30%% of its missing HP as cold damage.
power.runicskills.reforge_the_shadow.des: Your summoned Polar Bear gains +40%% HP and emits a Chill burst on death.
power.runicskills.glacial_sovereign.desc: After 3 ice casts in 15s, Chilled on nearby foes keeps being extended.
power.runicskills.static_cling.descripti: Chain Lightning's second-or-later target becomes Shocked for 4s.
power.runicskills.crackle_arc.descriptio: While Charged, melee attacks arc a 4-block bolt to the nearest other enemy.
power.runicskills.skybreaker.description: Airborne lightning spells deal +25%% damage; on kill, Ascension cooldown resets.
power.runicskills.conduit_mark.descripti: Chain Lightning tags the first target as a Conduit; detonated by Bolt/Lance/Ball.
power.runicskills.thunder_lord.descripti: For 4s after you deal lightning damage, lightning periodically strikes the nearest enemy.
power.runicskills.sanctified_strike.desc: +25%% damage on holy spells against Undead.
power.runicskills.fortifying_bond.descri: Casting Heal/Greater Heal/Blessing/Healing Circle on an ally grants you 3s of Fortify.
power.runicskills.guided_fate.descriptio: Projectiles against Guided targets deal +20%% damage and refund 20%% of that spell's cooldown.
power.runicskills.wings_of_judgment.desc: While Angel Wings are active, Sunbeam/Guiding Bolt deal +15%% and apply brief Slow IV.
power.runicskills.herald_of_dawn.descrip: When you fall below 30%% HP, emit a holy pulse: heal and Fortify yourself and nearby allies, smite foes already in combat (30s ICD).
power.runicskills.step_between.descripti: A spell teleport gives your next spell, within 1.5s, +20%% damage.
power.runicskills.arcane_echo.descriptio: Magic Missile / Magic Arrow hits have a 25%% chance to spawn a 40%% damage phantom copy.
power.runicskills.counterspell_riposte.d: Counterspelling grants +20%% damage on your next spell within 4s, whatever it hits.
power.runicskills.black_hole_resonance.d: While Black Hole is active, your spells +10%% damage vs pulled; kill-within extends it.
power.runicskills.unraveled.description: Lethal damage teleports you to where you were 3s ago with partial HP+mana (10-min ICD).
power.runicskills.fang_follow_through.de: After Fang Strike/Ward, your next melee deals +30%% and roots for 1s.
power.runicskills.vex_taunt.description: Your summoned Vex hits have a 30%% chance to redirect aggro for 3s.
power.runicskills.creeper_cascade_master: Chain Creeper gets +1 hop and a 25%% chance per detonation to spawn an extra homing head.
power.runicskills.shield_wall.descriptio: Shield spawns a second orthogonal panel (or between ally and threat). 20s ICD.
power.runicskills.tricksters_aria.descri: Projectile casts don't break Invisibility; the first hit after entering invis deals +50%%.
power.runicskills.rooted.description: While Oakskin is up and you haven't moved far for 3s, +20%% HP regen and knockback immunity.
power.runicskills.blight_spread.descript: A Blighted enemy dying transfers Blight to up to 3 nearby foes at 70%% duration.
power.runicskills.venomous_harvest.descr: Poisoned-enemy kills restore 10 mana and grant +15%% poison damage for 2s.
power.runicskills.the_grove_remembers.de: A target with 3+ of your debuffs takes +30%% damage and -50%% healing.
power.runicskills.crimson_tithe.descript: Heal for 10%% of blood-school damage you deal.
power.runicskills.marrow_sense.descripti: Below 50%% HP, your blood spells cast 15%% faster.
power.runicskills.sacrifice_cascade.desc: Sacrifice also bleeds nearby foes for 6s and refunds 15 mana.
power.runicskills.harvest_the_weak.descr: Killing a <30%% HP enemy with blood damage grants +1 max HP for 60s, stacking to +10.
power.runicskills.the_hearts_toll.descri: Blood spells deal +30%% but cost 5%% current HP; below 10%%, no HP cost but −50%% damage.
power.runicskills.forbidden_knowledge.de: For 10s after an Eldritch cast, foes you kill drop twice as much.
power.runicskills.kinetic_affinity.descr: A Telekinesis-held target takes +50%% fall and physical damage; dropping triggers a pulse.
power.runicskills.piercing_insight.descr: Sonic Boom / Eldritch Blast reveal enemies (glowing) and let your next spell ignore 50%% resist.
Below 20%% mana: Eldritch spells −50%% cost, +40%% damage. Above 80%% mana: −20%% damage.
power.runicskills.trueshot.description: Projectile hits on targets your camera was centered on deal +15%%.
power.runicskills.ricochet_primer.descri: The first projectile after 3s of not casting has a 25%% chance to pierce one extra entity.
power.runicskills.volley_memory.descript: Hitting the same target 3x in 5s makes the 4th hit deal +40%%.
power.runicskills.gravity_well.descripti: Hits on airborne enemies deal +25%% and apply 3s Slow Falling.
power.runicskills.arcanists_barrage.desc: Every 10th projectile landed in combat echoes itself for 75%% damage.
power.runicskills.unbroken_focus.descrip: Each full second of uninterrupted channeling adds +4%% damage (cap +20%%).
power.runicskills.tidal_draw.description: Channels slowly pull enemies within 6 blocks toward your aim.
power.runicskills.harmonic_resonance.des: Every 2s sustained, the channel's cone/AoE widens by 1 block (+3 cap).
power.runicskills.siphon_bond.descriptio: Lifesteal-channels also heal you at 25%% of their siphon rate.
power.runicskills.the_long_note.descript: Sustain a channel 4+ seconds to split 70%% damage onto a second target.
power.runicskills.pack_tactics.descripti: When 2+ of your summons hit the same foe in 2s, the second hit deals +25%%.
power.runicskills.fallen_echo.descriptio: When one of your summons dies, gain +15%% spell damage for 3s.
power.runicskills.soul_tether.descriptio: Summons within 8 blocks of you take −30%% damage; beyond 8, +30%%.
power.runicskills.lingering_binding.desc: Recasting (unsummoning) releases stored damage as an AoE burst at each summon's position.
power.runicskills.the_conductor.descript: Maintain two concurrent summon batches from different summon spells.
power.runicskills.phase_recoil.descripti: Projectiles fired within 1s after a teleport gain +15%% speed.
power.runicskills.vanishing_trail.descri: Teleporting leaves a decoy after-image that draws aggro for 2s.
power.runicskills.blink_strike.descripti: Your first attack or spell within 2s of a teleport deals +30%%.
power.runicskills.folded_space.descripti: For 3s after a teleport, your next teleport spell costs half mana.
power.runicskills.staff_strike.descripti: Staff melee attacks reduce your next spell's cast time by 20%% (2s window).
power.runicskills.spell_parry.descriptio: Blocking with a magic sword equipped reflects 20%% of spell damage to the caster.
power.runicskills.imbued_rhythm.descript: Alternating melee and spell casts adds +8%% damage per alternation (max +32%%).
power.runicskills.arcane_riposte.descrip: On-hit spell from your Magic Sword has its cooldown reduced by 30%%.
power.runicskills.warmages_covenant.desc: A critical melee hit gives your next spell, within 0.5s, +25%% damage.
power.runicskills.lingering_grace.descri: When a self-buff expires, your next spell within 3s refunds 25%% of its cooldown.
power.runicskills.shared_flame.descripti: Utility spells on self also apply (at 50%% duration) to allies within 4 blocks.
power.runicskills.shield_break_counter.d: When a Shield/Fortify barrier on you breaks, gain 3s of 40%% DR.
power.runicskills.empowered_dispel.descr: Cleanse on self grants your next spell bonus damage scaling with the removed debuff duration.
power.runicskills.the_still_mind.descrip: At full HP and full mana, your next spell deals +30%% and applies a school-appropriate debuff.
